findings.title: Excerpt-first recall silently loses subsequently fetched full body
findings.why_it_matters: A full-article analysis can be accepted as sufficient while the answer model receives only the initial 500-character vector excerpt. A query-based recall followed by the new deterministic full-body backstop produces the same vault/chunk evidence identity; merge_evidence keeps the first nonempty excerpt, and observation rendering truncates the later full body to 2,000 characters. In a compiled-graph replay with a 4,019-character segment and a decisive tail, the tail is absent from the answer prompt, yet completion reports material_status=sufficient, evidence_chars=500, body_pages=2 and outcome=answer.
findings.suggested_fix: When ordered body pages supersede vector excerpts for the same vault/chunk, upgrade the retained Evidence to the complete authorized segment (carry content_scope/provenance if needed) before deciding material sufficiency. Preserve deduplication and cite identity. Add a compiled-graph regression that performs query recall first, then ordered recall of the same chunk, and verifies a tail beyond both the 500-character excerpt and 2,000-character observation cap appears in the final model prompt.

findings.title: Planning envelopes bypass the final answer protocol guard
findings.why_it_matters: Final answers can still publish the exact text-JSON planning envelope as visible content and be marked successful. The filter checks tool_calls/function_calls and direct tool/args objects, but a decoded outer calls array is accepted and its nested call object is skipped; the planner itself uses this calls envelope. A second replay also accepts <tool_use name="recall_item">...</tool_use>, although native_plan already recognizes tool_use as a forbidden textual call. Both ordinary article-analysis requests emitted the raw protocol followed by done with repair_count=0.
findings.suggested_fix: Recognize nonempty calls arrays with tool/args entries as planning pseudo-calls, including when nested in a decoded object, and align XML opener coverage with the protocol forms recognized by native_plan (including tool_use/invoke). Keep the explicit current-question protocol-example exemption and bounded streaming buffering. Add chunk-split answer-service tests for these actual envelopes and require repair before visible output or typed failure afterward.
